outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of fluorescence micrographs only; no averaged/quantitative plot is shown.
The bar graphs (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean ± error bars without the underlying individual data points.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar graphs (n=15-26) display only group means with error bars; individual data points are not shown.
Panel E shows FACS histograms depicting the full distribution of TMRM intensity across individual cells rather than a summary average, so no additional individual data points are needed.
